filings.name: Tanla Platforms Limited
filings.label: Reply to exchange query (volume / price / news)
filings.subject: Clarification/Confirmation on news item appearing in “Media/Publication”
filings.summary: The Exchange has sought clarification from Tanla Platforms Limited with respect to recent news item captioned Tanla Platforms shares plunge 12% in 6 days amid SC's setback for subsidiary Karix Mobile; details about ₹375 cr dispute.  The response from the Company is attached.
filings.ns: Tanla Platforms Limited responded to NSE queries regarding a Livemint article about its subsidiary Karix Mobile. The article cited a Supreme Court setback in Writ Petition No. 1815/2026 concerning a NICSI tender. Tanla clarified the matter was non-commercial, involving only tender process disputes, with no negotiations or settlements. The company assessed the event under SEBI LODR Regulations and concluded no disclosure was required as it did not meet materiality thresholds or involve penalties. Tanla stated the issue had no material impact on the company or its share price. The company confirmed it is unaware of any undisclosed information explaining the recent share price movement. Tanla affirmed compliance with all SEBI LODR disclosure requirements.

filings.ns: Netweb Technologies India Limited has launched a new product named Skylus Workspace on 27.11.2026. The product is categorized as an Enterprise Digital Workspace Platform. The notice was issued by Lohit Chhabra, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.
